description: Platform imagery envelopes — ADVICE, never enforcement. Entity images (events, courses, articles) render on SEVERAL surfaces at once (cards, carousel slides, detail banners), including platform-owned components, so their guidance is platform-level: the envelope every surface can live with. Template-composed slots (the home hero) are different — their ideal is the TEMPLATE's own design call, declared per-template in manifest.imagery and surfaced beside the upload. Editors measure the actual upload against the relevant guidance and advise; the charity always decides.

eventPromo.note: One photo, several surfaces: the events card, the home carousel slide, and the event page banner — each crops differently, so keep the subject centred and avoid text baked into the image.

courseImage.note: Renders as the course card and the course page opener — subject centred, no baked-in text.

articleCover.note: The article card thumbnail and the article page cover — wide editorial shots sit best.
